name: Lightfully Behavioral Health
one_liner: California treatment centers with residential, day (PHP), intensive outpatient and virtual IOP mental health programs for teens and adults.
best_for: Adults in California who need more support than weekly therapy, such as residential or day treatment
Teens 12–17 in the San Diego area who need PHP or IOP
People stepping down from a hospital stay who need structured follow-on care
Anthem Blue Cross members in California
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988; for immediate danger call 911
People with mild symptoms who only need weekly outpatient therapy
People whose main problem is substance use (it is a mental health program)
short_description: California residential, PHP, IOP and virtual IOP programs for adults and teens with depression, anxiety, trauma and other conditions; insurance-based.
long_description: Lightfully Behavioral Health, founded in 2021, runs mental health treatment programs across California, with locations in the Los Angeles area (including Westwood, Santa Monica and Brentwood), Thousand Oaks, Santa Barbara, San Diego County (including Carlsbad and Encinitas), San Jose and Northern California. Levels of care are residential treatment, partial hospitalization (PHP), intensive outpatient (IOP) and a virtual IOP. Adult programs treat anxiety, depression, trauma, personality disorders, thought disorders and other conditions; teen programs (ages 12 to 17) are offered in the San Diego area. It describes a 'Precision Care Model' with weekly symptom measurement and publishes its own outcome figures, but no peer-reviewed study of its programs was found. It is in-network with Anthem Blue Cross in California and says it works with several major insurers; prices are quoted by admissions.
patient_summary: You call admissions, who check your insurance and recommend a level of care: live-in residential treatment, or day programs (PHP or IOP) several days a week at a center or by video. Programmes are for adults, with teen (12–17) programs in the San Diego area, and are mostly paid through insurance such as Anthem Blue Cross.

pricing.starting_price: Insurance-based; program cost quoted by admissions
pricing.notes: In-network with Anthem Blue Cross in California for all levels of care; says it works with several other major insurers. No self-pay price is published; admissions verifies benefits.

privacy.notes: The site's 'Privacy Policy' (read 2026-10-27) is a HIPAA Notice of Privacy Practices: it says Lightfully won't sell medical information without authorization or share SMS opt-in data, but there is no website policy covering advertising cookies or other data, and no deletion right.

faqs.q: What treatment levels does Lightfully offer?
faqs.a: Lightfully offers residential treatment, partial hospitalization (PHP), intensive outpatient (IOP), and virtual IOP programs for mental health conditions.
Lightfully reports 88% of depression patients show improvement at discharge, with 41% reduction in depression scores, 45% reduction in anxiety scores, and 32% reduction in PTSD scores.

faqs.q: What is Lightfully's Precision Care Model?
faqs.a: The Precision Care Model is Lightfully's proprietary approach combining evidence-based therapies to create personalized treatment plans based on patient goals rather than just symptoms.
Lightfully conducts weekly assessments with patients to track progress throughout treatment, measuring improvement in depression, anxiety, PTSD, and psychological distress.

primary_uses: Intensive outpatient (IOP), in person or virtual

availability.note: California only. Adult programs at several sites; teen (12–17) programs in the San Diego area; virtual IOP for California residents.
